english: the bigger they come, the harder they fall
also: the higher they climb, the harder they fall

terms.comment: Literally “a fall from on high does harm far more easily”. We have found no ancient source for it in Lewis & Short or the loci collections.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, cited by printed page; each phrase checked against the searchable text of the book.
